rules: ChatGPT page missing: create page inside same browser
CDP degraded while shared-mcp browser process exists: never relaunch browser
browser process truly absent on consecutive checks: launch once
human verification: record/pause, no brute-force/relaunch loop
transport disconnect: degrade/observe, do not treat as immediate task death

globalWriter.purpose: read-only monitors may coexist; New chat/navigation/composer/send are single-writer only

rootCauseFixed: per-task runtime previously could launchPersistentContext directly instead of reusing the existing browser
Playwright MCP shared-browser-context was incorrectly treated as process-independent page persistence
per-lease-root ownership did not prevent two writers using different roots

openGate.meaning: Recovery, true-New-chat continuation, watchdog, backup failover and writer fencing have real evidence; an intentionally/naturally stalled long ChatGPT turn has not yet been run through the complete detect→classify→checkpoint→recover lifecycle as one single Reality.
